approvalScope.A_home_page: skald/index.html rewritten for Skald: the Greeks: name, title and metadata; hero; the four-number strip (17 works, 58 translations, 15,162 reading notes, 565 pictures); a new section for the Greek library with its five shelves; Odyssey-only features labelled as such; the Odyssey museum figures corrected to 229 works from 47 museums and collections plus 29 other historical works (258 distinct); FAQ answers for the rename, the contents, translations, languages, Greek and price; final call to action.
approvalScope.B_get_page: skald/get/index.html: name, heading and the one-line summary.
approvalScope.C_share_card: assets/skald-the-greeks-og.jpg (1200x630), referenced by og:image and twitter:image with ?v=20261117; the older cards stay served for links already shared.
approvalScope.D_name_only: Product name only on updates/index.html (header, metadata, back link; its posts are the published ones), support/index.html, feedback/index.html, feedback/privacy/index.html, updates-privacy/index.html (with 'Last updated: 2026-11-17 (app name only)') and waitlist-privacy/index.html; app.js form title.
approvalScope.E_layout: styles.css gains the rules for the library section and the five-shelf list; the header menu reads Library, Translations, Notes & scholarship, Questions, Updates, Translation Atlas.
approvalScope.ownerRuling: Owner, 2026-11-17: "The skald website needs to be updated. It's odyssey specific".
approvalScope.arbiterEditsApplied: All eleven resolved edits of FINAL-ARBITRATION.md are applied in the approved index.html.
